headerfooter.editHeaderTip: Edit this page's header. You can also double-click the top margin.
headerfooter.editFooterTip: Edit this page's footer. You can also double-click the bottom margin.
headerfooter.field.pageTip: Insert the page number at the caret. Every page shows its own number.
headerfooter.field.pagesTip: Insert the document's number of pages at the caret.
headerfooter.field.dateTip: Insert today's date at the caret. It shows the date of the day the document is opened.
headerfooter.titlePageTip: The first page of this section gets its own header, footer and page number (a cover page).
headerfooter.evenOddTip: Even pages get their own header and footer. This is a setting of the whole document.
headerfooter.linkTip: When on, this section uses the previous section's header and footer. Turn it off to change this section alone.
headerfooter.closeTip: Finish editing the header and footer and go back to the body.
headerfooter.pageNumber.title: Page numbers
headerfooter.pageNumber.sub: Where page numbers go from this section on, and how they look — the HWPX page-numbering model.
headerfooter.pageNumber.restart: Start again in this section at
headerfooter.pageNumber.note: Saved as DOCX, the number becomes a page-number frame in the header or footer; saved as HWPX, it is HWPX page numbering.
headerfooter.pageNumber.tip: Position, format and starting number of the page numbers.
headerfooter.toast.docOnly: Headers and footers belong to document pages.
headerfooter.toast.fieldNeedsText: Fields can be inserted while editing a header, footer or text box.
engine.officeSurgeon.hfPicture: Pictures and shapes in an edited header or footer are left out.
